title: Authorize worker_env_strips_pat integration test in prd frontmatter
body:
**Chose:** Leave prd.md frontmatter `authorized_tests` unchanged this slice; the new test ships in the diff and the owner adds `tests/worker.rs::worker_env_strips_pat_disables_autocorrect_and_blocks_explicit_pushurl` before checkpoint testguard.
**Over:** Editing prd frontmatter in the worker (forbidden under Autonomy Never).
**Because:** FR-3 acceptance names the test; testguard reads the run-start snapshot, so the line must land with the merge, not mid-slice.
**Undo:** Add the quoted entry to `authorized_tests` in `docs/features/028-multi-provider-hardening/prd.md`.
Review: decide

title: Harness origin remote affects worker git_config counts
body: Harness fixtures always `git remote add origin` a bare repo; worker tests that assert exact `GIT_CONFIG_COUNT` must include the dynamic `remote.*.url` entry (count 7/8), not the slice-time assumption of “no remotes”.
